title: 第16章 第一个任务第17章 诱饵
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
对于任务的接取，沃尔是有所考虑的。
虽然这三个任务，沃尔都有信心能完成，表面上看，哥布林是凶残的魔物，数量也最多，虽然奖金高，却最是凶险。
但这就不得不说一下哥布林了，据职业者学校的资料记载，它们最早出现在五千多年前的魔神之战中。
它们原本是地精的一支，但最终反叛到深渊恶魔那边，被欲望领主改造成为扭曲的魔物。
普通的哥布林实力和智力都很低下，但仍然具备可怕的寄生能力，它们同时具备两性，能够自体繁殖，不过母体并不能提供胚胎足够的营养，所以需要其他种族的寄生母体。
上一次，沃尔在地摊上看到的哥布林牛牛，其实是它的体外排卵器。
哥布林会捕捉中体型以上的生物作为寄生母体，而越强的母体，就会孕育出越强的哥布林。
大哥布林、熊哥布林、甚至是龙脉哥布林，这些异化个体不仅智力高、实力强，还能聚集大型哥布林部落，甚至能对附近的人类城镇造成危害。
沃尔选择它们的原因很简单，普通哥布林只有野兽级智力，甚至比不过狼群和巨棕熊。
只要把握时机，沃尔认为自己的部队能够一战将其剿灭！
工作人员检查了沃尔的身份信息后，便取下墙上那张通告，带他到窗口进行登记：
“战旗冒险团，赤铜级，由一位赤铜冒险者，10位黑铁冒险者组成，第一次就接取这种危险任务吗？”
面对问询，沃尔侧身展示自己的队友。
里面的工作人员看到全身铁甲的10个士兵了然，麻溜地开具凭证，并将一份详细资料一起递交给沃尔。
“这次委托任务周期为五天，请您在此之前回到这里进行任务闭环。”
沃尔接过资料立刻仔细阅读起来。
上面详细描述了村庄的位置，以及对哥布林部落的几次目击情况。
十几只哥布林对农庄进行了几次骚扰，都被提前发现的农民们聚集起来吓跑，只带走放养的几只肉羊。
因为这是一个没有采邑骑士的自由农庄，头人为了宝贵的人力安全，很快选择破财消灾，遣人到最近的青木镇发布任务。
没发现什么问题，沃尔便带着部队回去铁魔像守护酒店，让士兵们好好休息。

第二天一大早，太阳还没有升起，沃尔和他的士兵们便早早起床，先是到院子里活动一番热身，这才穿戴好装备出门。
队伍兵分两路，沃尔带着两个士兵去铁翼护具店取盔甲，其他人则按照昨天的安排，去冒险者广场购买一些出任务必备的零碎物品。
铁翼护具店内，沃尔拿到了完整的，崭亮如新的板链甲。
这是一套复合型甲胄，内层为锁子甲，外层镶嵌着大块钢条组成的板甲部件，总重达30公斤，价值30金币往上。
咔哒咔哒——
最后戴上全封闭式头盔，将面罩拉下，沃尔便成为了一座移动的铁堡垒！
“感觉比预料中轻松很多嘛！”
沃尔活动着身体，不断发出咔哒咔哒的金属摩擦声。
板甲有着支撑结构，并不用沃尔负担全部重量。
从狭小的缝隙观察外面的世界，沃尔感到了一种少有的安心。
content_en:
Wall had some considerations when accepting the task.
Although Wall is confident that he can complete these three tasks, on the surface, Goblins are ferocious monsters and have the largest number. Although the reward is high, they are the most dangerous.
But we have to talk about goblins. According to the records of the professional school, they first appeared in the War of Demon Gods more than 5,000 years ago.
They were originally a branch of goblins, but eventually rebelled against the abyss demons and were transformed into twisted monsters by the Lord of Desire.
Ordinary goblins have low strength and intelligence, but they still have terrible parasitic abilities. They have both sexes at the same time and can reproduce themselves. However, the mother body cannot provide enough nutrition for the embryo, so it needs a parasitic mother body from other races.
The last time, the Goblin Cow that Wall saw on the street stall was actually its external ovulator.
Goblins will capture creatures of medium size and above as parasitic mothers, and the stronger the mother, the stronger the goblin will be.
Big Goblin, Bear Goblin, and even Dragon Veined Goblin, these alienated individuals are not only highly intelligent and powerful, they can also gather large goblin tribes and even cause harm to nearby human towns.
The reason why Wall chose them is simple. Ordinary goblins only have beast-level intelligence, not even comparable to wolves and giant brown bears.
As long as he seizes the opportunity, Wall believes that his troops can destroy them in one battle!
After the staff checked Wall's identity information, they took down the notice on the wall and took him to the window to register:
"The Battle Flag Adventure Group, copper level, consists of one copper adventurer and 10 black iron adventurers. Is this your first time to take on such a dangerous mission?"
When asked, Wall turned sideways to show off his teammates.
When the staff inside saw the 10 soldiers in full armor, they immediately issued a voucher and handed a detailed document to Wall.
"This commissioned task period is five days. Please come back here before that to complete the task loop."
Wall took the information and immediately read it carefully.
It details the location of the village, as well as several sightings of goblin hordes.
More than a dozen goblins harassed the farm several times, but the farmers who discovered it in advance gathered and scared them away, taking away only a few sheep.
Because this was a free farm without any fief knights, the leader quickly chose to spend money to eliminate the disaster and sent people to the nearest Aoki Town to issue tasks for the safety of his precious manpower.
Not finding any problems, Wall took his troops back to the Iron Golem Guard Hotel to let the soldiers have a good rest.
Early the next morning, before the sun had risen, Wall and his soldiers got up early and went to the yard to warm up before putting on their equipment and going out.
The team was divided into two groups. Wall took two soldiers to the Iron Wing Protective Equipment Store to pick up armor, while the others went to the Adventurer Plaza to buy some odds and ends necessary for the mission according to yesterday's arrangement.
In the Iron Wing protective gear store, Wall got a complete plate and chain armor that was as bright as new.
This is a set of composite armor. The inner layer is chain mail, and the outer layer is inlaid with plate armor components composed of large steel bars. The total weight is 30 kilograms and is worth 30 gold coins upwards.
Click click click——
Finally, put on a fully enclosed helmet and pull down the visor, and Wall becomes a mobile iron fortress!
“It feels much easier than expected!”
Wall moved his body, making constant clicking sounds of metal friction.
The plate armor has a supporting structure, so Wall does not have to bear all the weight.
Observing the outside world through the narrow gap, Wall felt a rare sense of peace of mind.
